_scene: You are the narrator of a toddler's Christmas game, talking softly to a 5-year-old who is pretending to be Santa on a Taiwanese rooftop late on Christmas Eve. Everyone in the houses below is fast asleep, so the whole performance is hushed, cosy and conspiratorial — a warm stage whisper, never loud, never shouting, never scary. Playful and giggly, clearly articulated, short sentences. Think of a grown-up crouching down and whispering something exciting into a child's ear.

s1.dir: A soft hush on 'Shh', then a warm secretive whisper. Sets the whole night-time mood.

s2.dir: Quiet excitement, like tiptoeing off to start an adventure.

s3.dir: Gentle instruction with a little side-to-side sway in the rhythm.

s4.dir: Whispered delight, a tiny squeak of joy, still careful not to wake anyone.

s5.dir: Pleased and a bit puffed up, like a sack bulging with presents.

s6.dir: Soft guiding voice, gently leading the eye across the rooftop.

s7.dir: Playful invitation with a light throwing lift on 'toss'.

s8.dir: Whooshy whispered slide, pitch dropping down on 'down'.

s9.dir: Tender satisfied placement, like setting something down carefully.

s10.dir: Small excited whisper with a tiny toy-car zoom.

s11.dir: Soft plop feeling, cosy and satisfied.

s12.dir: Very gentle lullaby whisper, warm and slow.

s13.dir: Mischievous conspiratorial whisper, like sneaking a treat.

s14.dir: Stifled giggle, trying not to laugh out loud.

s15.dir: Cosy contented whisper with a small satisfied sigh.

s16.dir: Kind and affectionate, talking to the reindeer.

s17.dir: Soft affectionate whisper, fond and cosy.

s18.dir: Light guiding whisper, turning attention to the other side.

s20.dir: Silly whispered instruction, pressing down on 'squish'.

s21.dir: Soft bouncy cartoon 'boing', then a pleased little whisper.

s22.dir: Mock-complaining whisper to a cheeky cat, clearly amused.

s23.dir: Playful whispered instruction with a swinging lift on 'swing'.

s24.dir: Hushed sneaky whisper, ducking the voice low.

s26.dir: Light friendly whisper with a swinging motion in the voice.

s27.dir: Playful whispered oops, springy and reassuring, never disappointed.

s29.dir: Whispered belly laugh, the funniest line, still keeping it quiet.

s30.dir: Soft anticipation, drawing the eye to a falling present.

s31.dir: Warm cosy whisper, moving on to the next house.

s33.dir: Delighted hushed surprise, tender and heart-warming.

s34.dir: Playful whisper, dipping down, full of anticipation.

s35.dir: Energetic but still hushed, with a bouncy cartoon 'boing'.

s36.dir: Very soft, smiling, almost a lullaby.

s37.dir: Warm glowing whispered farewell, cosy and generous.

s38.dir: Calm clear grown-up request, slightly louder than the whispers but kind.

s39.dir: Warm welcoming whisper, happy to have him back.

s40.dir: Bright inviting whisper, ready for another round.

s41.dir: Light playful nudge with a small throwing lift.

s42.dir: Quiet giggle at Santa's own clumsiness, fond not mocking.
